items.label: Founded
items.note: The factory has been running since 2011.

items.label: Monthly capacity
items.note: Our bulk lines run around the clock with a capacity of about 100,000 pieces a month, scaling from small runs to large volumes. Alongside them, our in-house design team handles pattern design, grading and fit development, and our sampling studio has a team of 65 that completes about 55 custom samples a day.
